title: v6 pair separability check
description: Whether a reply that fits one condition of an item would also fit the other. Both vocalizations can be individually plausible and the pair still be useless for ranking: if the acceptable replies overlap, a judge asked which reply suits which version is choosing between two equally good answers, and the ranking score measures nothing. Checked before the dataset is frozen, because a failure means regenerating the item from a new seed.

separable.description: false when a natural reply appropriate for one condition would often be fully appropriate for the other

overlap.description: what the two conditions' acceptable replies share, and whether anything separates them

example_response_fitting_both.description: a natural reply that fits both, when there is one; empty otherwise

which_side_is_weaker.description: the condition whose framing the transcript supports least, when one is weaker
